title: Unpacking Security Scanners for GitHub Actions Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2601.14455v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: GitHub Actions is a widely used platform to automate the build and deployment of software projects through configurable workflows. As the platform's popularity grows, it also becomes a target of choice for software supply chain attacks. These attacks exploit excessive permissions, ambiguous versions or the absence of artifact integrity checks to compromise the workflows. In response to these attacks, several security scanners have emerged to help developers harden their workflows. In this paper, we perform the first systematic comparison of 9 GitHub Actions Workflows security scanners. We compare them regarding scope (which security weaknesses they target), detection capabilities (how many weaknesses they detect), accuracy (how well their findings match manually confirmed weaknesses), and performance (how long they take to scan a workflow). translated_title: 解析GitHub Actions工作流安全扫描器
translated_abstract: GitHub Actions是一个广泛使用的平台，通过可配置的工作流来自动化软件项目的构建与部署。随着该平台日益流行，它也成为了软件供应链攻击的首选目标。这些攻击利用过度权限、版本不明确或缺乏制品完整性检查等弱点来破坏工作流。为应对这些攻击，目前已出现多种安全扫描器来帮助开发者加固其工作流。在本文中，我们首次对9个GitHub Actions工作流安全扫描器进行了系统性比较。我们从以下几个方面对它们进行比较：范围（针对哪些安全弱点）、检测能力（能检测出多少弱点）、准确性（其检测结果与人工确认的弱点的匹配程度）以及性能（扫描一个工作流所需的时间）。为了在共同的基础上比较这些扫描器，我们首先建立了一个包含10种……的分类体系。
tldr: 本文首次对9个GitHub Actions工作流安全扫描器进行了系统性比较，从范围、检测能力、准确性和性能四个维度评估了它们的安全检测效果。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic comparison of 9 GitHub Actions workflow security scanners, evaluating them in terms of scope, detection capabilities, accuracy, and performance.
